standard_references.evidence: Supplied official-source excerpt shows SDMX Glossary entries including Metadata Structure Definition, Metadata Set, Metadata update, and a cross-domain concept entry for Geographical coverage with Concept ID COVERAGE_GEO and recommended representation String; Codelist.

Supplied official-source excerpt shows the SDMX Global Registry interface includes Codelists and Metadata / Metadata Structures among searchable artefact categories; it does not confirm any specific health-domain codelist or metadata concept scheme version for this report.

The guideline URL is supplied in the principles as a recommended source for SDMX reference metadata concepts, but no fetched external excerpt confirming exact concept IDs, definitions and versions from that guideline was supplied in the evidence package.

Supplied official-source excerpt shows UN M49 country and area entries with numeric and alpha codes. The report areas Northland, Centralia and South Coast are synthetic/local area labels and are not confirmed as UN M49 areas from the supplied excerpt.

limitations: The report provides reference-metadata values for title, publisher, publication date, methodology, source description, definitions, caveats, revision policy and confidentiality, but it does not provide contact details, source URL, legal mandate or metadata update date.

Exact SDMX Global Reference Metadata Concept Scheme IDs and versions are not confirmed from supplied external evidence for most candidate concepts such as DATA_REV, CONF, COMPLETENESS, CONTACT and COMPILING_ORG; these are treated as candidate mappings rather than confirmed reuse.

The report explicitly indicates that mortality and hospital beds should not share the mortality DSD; this MSD therefore separates mortality and hospital-capacity metadata while retaining common report-level metadata.
Cause labels are only described as resembling broad ICD families; no ICD version is confirmed, so the MSD includes limitation and definition metadata rather than asserting an ICD classification.
Geographic labels in the report are synthetic/local and are not confirmed against UN M49 or ISO 3166 from the supplied evidence.
This artifact defines metadata structures only; actual metadata values belong in a separate Metadata Set.

metadata_structures.name: Health Outcomes and Capacity Report reference metadata

concepts.name: Report title
concepts.definition: Title or name of the publication to which the metadata applies.
concepts.extraction_guidance: Extract the publication title from the cover or page heading. In this report, use the health outcomes and capacity report title rather than the file-name-like document title if both are captured separately in a metadata set.
concepts.source_standard: LOCAL concept; no exact confirmed SDMX concept ID supplied in external evidence

concepts.name: Publisher
concepts.definition: Organisation responsible for publishing the report.
concepts.representation: Text or organisation identifier where a confirmed organisation scheme exists
concepts.extraction_guidance: Extract the publishing organisation named near the report title.
concepts.source_standard: LOCAL concept; possible mapping to SDMX organisation metadata requires confirmation

concepts.name: Publication date
concepts.definition: Date on which the report or publication was issued.
concepts.extraction_guidance: Extract the publication date from the report front matter and normalise to an ISO date in the metadata set while preserving the source text there if required.
concepts.source_standard: LOCAL concept; no exact confirmed SDMX concept ID supplied in external evidence

concepts.name: Source URL
concepts.definition: Web location or persistent identifier from which the report or data source can be accessed.
concepts.extraction_guidance: Populate only if a URL or persistent identifier is stated in the report or provenance. The supplied report context does not state one.
concepts.source_standard: LOCAL concept

concepts.name: Contact
concepts.definition: Contact point for questions about the report, data or metadata.
concepts.representation: Text; may be structured as name, organisation, email and role if available
concepts.extraction_guidance: Extract only if a contact point is explicitly stated. The supplied report context does not state contact information.
concepts.source_standard: SDMX reference metadata concept candidate; exact concept scheme/version not confirmed from supplied external evidence

concepts.name: Metadata update
concepts.definition: Date or statement indicating when the reference metadata was last updated or certified.
concepts.extraction_guidance: Extract if the report states a metadata update date. If absent, record as not stated in the metadata set rather than inferring it from the publication date.
concepts.source_standard: SDMX Glossary 2.1 concept candidate; supplied excerpt confirms the term Metadata update but not a complete implementation context for this report

concepts.name: Data description
concepts.definition: Summary of the statistical content and main variables covered by the mortality dataflow.
concepts.extraction_guidance: Describe the mortality table content without turning methodology into dimensions. Use the report sections and the table heading for registered deaths by area, cause, age and year.
concepts.source_standard: SDMX reference metadata concept candidate; exact concept ID not confirmed from supplied external evidence

concepts.name: Source data

concepts.name: Methodology

concepts.extraction_guidance: Extract the mortality-specific methodology. Preserve the statement that deaths are synthetic registered events classified by underlying cause and age group; do not force this narrative into DSD dimensions beyond the actual statistical dimensions.
